headline: Jaro Institute allots equity shares under employee stock option plan
hook: Employee stock options exercised at Jaro
summary: Jaro Institute of Technology Management and Research Limited has announced the approval and allotment of 6,973 fully paid-up equity shares of Rs 10 each. This allotment follows the exercise of options granted under the Jaro Education Employee Stock Option Plan 2022. Such routine ESOP allotments marginally increase the company's total paid-up equity capital. For Indian retail investors, this is standard corporate housekeeping with negligible impact on stock price or market liquidity.
why_it_matters: Routine equity expansion with no impact on retail portfolio value
